results.title: Ather EL Platform Electric Scooter Teased Ahead of August 29 Launch
results.description: Ather Energy has teased its upcoming EL Platform-based electric scooter ahead of its August 29, 2026 debut. Designed for mass-market commuters, the new EV features a metal body, 14-inch front wheel, 12-inch rear wheel, and supports 2kWh to 5kWh battery options. Expected price is Rs 1 lakh-Rs 1.25 L

results.title: Maruti Suzuki July sales: Domestic volumes cross 2 lakh units for first time, total sales up 34%
results.description: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd. reported a 33.7% rise in total sales in July 2026, selling 2,41,421 units. Domestic sales hit a record 2,00,123 units.
